title: wt rescue result
description: The one document `wt rescue --json` prints, on success, refusal and failure (nothing else goes to stdout). `outcome` is one of `moved` (the work was copied and verified), `would_move` (a dry run: it would be), `refused` (a check failed before anything was created; `created` is false) or `failed` (something went wrong; `created` says whether the new branch and worktree exist: when true they are KEPT, never rolled back, at `destination.path`). `code` is the stable refusal or failure code; `reason` one sanitised line (at most 200 characters, so it may be cut). `source` is the worktree the work came from (`ref` is absent for a detached worktree); the source is only read and never changed. `destination` is present once a name was chosen: the new branch, its worktree path and the full commit id it starts at (the source's exact HEAD, so every commit comes with it). `carried` and `left_behind` count what is (or would be) copied and what is not (ignored entries stay behind). `completed` lists the steps that finished; `warnings` holds sanitised lines (always arrays). `moved` does NOT make the source removable: it still reads as having work only it holds. A run that failed before any outcome (no match, ambiguous argument, usage error, a registry or repository that could not be read) has `error` and none of `outcome`, `source`, `destination`, `carried`, `left_behind`. `name`s, paths and refs are raw identifiers carried verbatim: JSON escapes only C0 controls, so a consumer MUST escape them before printing to a terminal. Pinned to wt/internal/rescue/json.go by wt/cmd/wt/rescue_contract_test.go; a key or code added there must be added here and in the samples in the same change.

code.description: Present for a refused or failed outcome.

created.description: Whether the new branch and worktree exist now.

ref.description: A full refname; absent for a detached worktree.

head.description: Full commit id of the source's HEAD.

start.description: Full commit id the new branch starts at.

commits.description: Commits reachable from no remote-tracking ref (0 when not counted).
